knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
# importing libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```


```{python}
read_csv("data/process_grid.csv")
```


```{r}
full_grid_tib %>%
    mutate(plant_sum = rowSums(full_grid_tib[,6:12])) %>%
    select(plant_sum, n_quercus, n_xerophyllum, n_thuja, n_populus, n_rubus, n_pinus, n_salix, n_fires)

full_grid_tib %>%
    mutate(plant_sum = rowSums(full_grid_tib[,6:12])) %>%    
    mutate(is_indigenous = as_factor(is_indigenous)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=plant_sum, color=is_indigenous)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno") +
    scale_colour_discrete(palette=c("white", "black")) +
    theme_void()

full_grid_tib %>%
    mutate(plant_sum = rowSums(full_grid_tib[,6:12])) %>%    
    mutate(is_indigenous = as_factor(is_indigenous)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=plant_sum, color=is_indigenous)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.1) +
    scale_fill_binned(breaks=c(0, 1, 10, 100), palette=c("red", "blue", "navy", "black")) +
    scale_colour_discrete(palette=c("white", "black")) +
    theme_void()
```
